positive_snippets: Compared to the other Sunstar hotels , this one is little compact and not that comfortable. Also not that spacious. But ok for a decent stay or short stay. Good room service. Good manager. Decent bathrooms. Kettle is there. Mini fridge is there. Good hot water provided even during winters .

This was the best hotel I’ve stayed at in Delhi. The staff were really friendly and welcoming from the start.

The hotel is in a quiet area and offers great luxury at a reasonable price. The team always listened to any concerns and helped solve them quickly.

What I Loved
- Very friendly and helpful staff
- They listen and solve problems quickly
- Rooms were very clean
- Good storage space and safe in the room for valuables

Room for Improvement
- No information card in the room with WiFi password, front desk number, or hot water timings
- Bathroom sink tap had weak water flow

Important Note
If you book the Superior Room on MakeMyTrip, the bathroom might look different from the photos. But it’s still good enough if you’re traveling alone.

Overall
I highly recommend this place for the great service, cleanliness, and good value for money.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

My stay at Hotel Sun Star Grand was excellent. The rooms were clean and well-maintained, and the staff was very polite and helpful. The check-in process was smooth, and the overall environment felt safe and comfortable.
Room service was quick, and all the facilities provided were exactly as mentioned during booking. The location is also very convenient with easy access to nearby places.
Overall, it was a great experience and truly value for money. Highly recommended!
